validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false"/>
    <data id="user" expr="({name:'bob'})"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" cond="count === = 3" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: ecmascript syntax error in `cond`: unexpected `=` where an operand was expected
notes: a condition that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` and evaluates as false, so this condition can never hold
diagnostics.help: `===` is already a complete operator; remove the stray `=` after it

fixes.message: remove the stray `=` and compare with `===`
